steps.stdout:
Change a project's name, slug, description or icon; the rest is kept.

With --json the report has from, to and unread: the fields the read before
the write lacked, whose from is "". A description the read sent as null was
read, and is not among them.

Usage:
  kaneo project update <project-id> [flags]

Flags:
  -d, --description string   new description; empty clears it
  -h, --help                 help for update
      --icon string          new icon name
      --name string          new name
      --slug string          new url slug (the prefix of task identifiers)

Global Flags:
      --api-key string     API key; prefer KANEO_API_KEY, since a flag is visible in the process list
      --api-url string     Kaneo base URL (env KANEO_API_URL)
      --human              force human-readable output, even through a pipe
      --jq string          filter JSON output with a jq expression (implies --json)
      --json               force JSON output
  -p, --project string     project id, slug or name (env KANEO_PROJECT)
      --timeout duration   per-request timeout (default 10s)
  -w, --workspace string   workspace id, slug or name (env KANEO_WORKSPACE)
